prompt.en: Friends are making a tiny listening event for music they enjoy. Which part would you most like to shape?
prompt.zh: 朋友想办一场小小的音乐欣赏活动，你最想参与哪部分？

label.en: Keep a clear creative idea that makes the event feel like ours.
label.zh: 守住一个让这场活动有自己表达的创意。

label.en: Make the shared evening feel welcoming in small everyday ways.
label.zh: 用日常小细节让一起度过的晚上更温暖。

label.en: Spend time refining one small piece of the listening experience.
label.zh: 花点时间认真打磨聆听体验的一小部分。

label.en: Fit the agreed plan to the time, room and equipment available.
label.zh: 把约好的计划和现有时间、房间、设备配好。

prompt.en: Two friends are arranging a shared corner for their hobby materials. What would you prefer to add?
prompt.zh: 两位朋友整理共用的兴趣材料角落，你更愿意加些什么？

label.en: A small everyday ritual that makes using the corner feel shared.
label.zh: 一个让使用这个角落有共同感的小习惯。

label.en: Careful work on the detail that matters to the activity itself.
label.zh: 把和活动本身有关的一处细节细细做好。

label.en: A realistic list of the materials and space we can use.
label.zh: 列清现有材料与可用空间。

label.en: A plain explanation of what I like and hope to contribute.
label.zh: 直接说说自己喜欢什么、想贡献什么。

prompt.en: You have a short session to prepare an original hobby piece. Which approach appeals most?
prompt.zh: 有一小段时间准备原创兴趣作品，你更喜欢哪种做法？

label.en: Work closely on one passage or detail until it feels more settled.
label.zh: 专注于一个段落或细节，慢慢把它做稳。

label.en: Choose a workable scope and allocate the limited session accordingly.
label.zh: 先选能完成的范围，再分配有限时间。

label.en: Tell a partner honestly which part I am excited to share.
label.zh: 坦率告诉伙伴，自己最想分享哪一部分。

label.en: Try a different role or technique while keeping the choice my own.
label.zh: 试一个新角色或新方法，同时自己决定怎么试。

prompt.en: A small creative meet-up has more ideas than available time. What would you prefer to do first?
prompt.zh: 一次小型创作聚会的点子比可用时间多，你更想先做什么？

label.en: Agree on a manageable aim and the resources it will need.
label.zh: 先约定能做到的目标和所需资源。

label.en: Say directly which idea matters most to me and why.
label.zh: 直接说哪一个点子对自己最有意义，以及原因。

label.en: Look for a flexible version that lets people try unfamiliar parts.
label.zh: 找一个灵活版本，让大家能试陌生的部分。

label.en: Clarify who can decide what and how to handle a disagreement.
label.zh: 说清谁可以决定什么，以及分歧怎样协调。

prompt.en: Someone invites you to join an informal creative group. Which first contribution feels closest?
prompt.zh: 有人邀请你加入非正式创作小组，你更接近哪种初次贡献？

label.en: Express genuine appreciation for a specific part of their work.
label.zh: 具体而真诚地说出欣赏对方作品哪里。

label.en: Explore a small role I can adapt while getting to know the group.
label.zh: 先试一个能边熟悉边调整的小角色。

label.en: Ask what responsibilities and limits everyone has agreed on.
label.zh: 问清大家约好了哪些责任和范围。

label.en: Bring an idea that I want to express in my own way.
label.zh: 带来一个想用自己方式表达的点子。

prompt.en: A new member can choose among several roles for a hobby session. What would appeal most to you?
prompt.zh: 新成员可以在兴趣活动里选几种分工，如果是你，什么最吸引你？

label.en: Room to try a role and adjust it after seeing how it fits.
label.zh: 可以先试，再看是否适合自己来调整。

label.en: An explicit agreement about what support the role can rely on.
label.zh: 明确约好这个角色可以得到哪些支持。

label.en: A role that leaves space for a recognisable creative voice.
label.zh: 一个能保留鲜明创作表达的位置。

label.en: A way to make ordinary time with the group feel connected.
label.zh: 一种让平常相处也有联结感的参与方式。

prompt.en: People disagree about the running order of a small sharing session. Which contribution would you choose?
prompt.zh: 小型分享活动的顺序有分歧，你更愿意作哪种贡献？

label.en: Make room for each need and agree how the decision will be made.
label.zh: 让各方需要被说到，再约好怎样决定。

label.en: Explain which order best preserves the creative idea I care about.
label.zh: 说清哪种顺序能保留自己在意的创意表达。

label.en: Find a small shared moment that makes the order less tense.
label.zh: 找一点能一起享受的小环节，让顺序不那么紧绷。

label.en: Refine the transition between two pieces so either order works better.
label.zh: 打磨两段内容之间的衔接，让两种顺序都更顺。

prompt.en: Your group is making a short self-published zine. What would you most like to protect?
prompt.zh: 小组制作一本短短的自印小刊，你最想保留什么？

label.en: The distinctive idea that made us want to make it.
label.zh: 最初让大家想做它的独特表达。

label.en: The small contributions that make it feel like time spent together.
label.zh: 那些让它有共同相处记忆的小贡献。

label.en: The care put into a particular page or sequence.
label.zh: 某一页或一组内容经过细细打磨的感觉。

label.en: A scope we can finish with the paper and time we actually have.
label.zh: 用现有纸张和时间可以做完的范围。

prompt.en: A shared evening at home has no special occasion. Which addition appeals most?
prompt.zh: 共同在家的普通晚上没有特别安排，你更喜欢加点什么？

label.en: A small familiar gesture that makes the evening feel shared.
label.zh: 一点让普通晚上有共同感的熟悉心意。

label.en: Unhurried time to work on a personal creative detail.
label.zh: 留一段不急的时间打磨自己的创作细节。

label.en: A workable arrangement for the room, supplies and available time.
label.zh: 把房间、用品和可用时间安排得现实一些。

label.en: An open conversation about something I am genuinely enjoying.
label.zh: 坦率聊聊自己最近真正喜欢的一件事。

prompt.en: You return to a hobby piece after receiving several suggestions. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 一件兴趣作品收到了几条建议，再打开它时你更愿意怎样做？

label.en: Practise the specific detail I most want to improve.
label.zh: 练一练自己最想做好的具体细节。

label.en: Choose which changes fit the time and materials I can invest.
label.zh: 选出符合自己可投入时间、材料的改动。

label.en: Explain honestly which suggestions connect with what I meant.
label.zh: 坦率说明哪些建议和自己的原意对得上。

label.en: Experiment with an unfamiliar version before deciding what to keep.
label.zh: 先试一版陌生做法，再决定留什么。

prompt.en: A group has one spare room and several possible creative plans. What interests you first?
prompt.zh: 小组有一个空房间和几种创作计划，你首先关心什么？

label.en: Which plan the space and available resources can support.
label.zh: 这个空间和现有资源能支持哪种计划。

label.en: Which plan people actually want, expressed in their own words.
label.zh: 大家各自真正想做什么，能否亲口说清。

label.en: Whether we can test different uses without locking everyone into one.
label.zh: 能否试几种用法，不急着把大家固定在一种里。

label.en: How we will share decisions and responsibility for the space.
label.zh: 空间的决定权和责任怎样共同约定。

prompt.en: Someone shares an early recording or sketch with you. Which response feels most natural to offer?
prompt.zh: 有人把早期录音或草图发给你，你更自然地想怎样回应？

label.en: Say specifically what I appreciate and what I actually heard or saw.
label.zh: 具体说欣赏哪里，也说清自己实际听到、看到什么。

label.en: Ask whether they would enjoy testing an alternative version together.
label.zh: 问愿不愿一起试一个不同版本。

label.en: Clarify whether they want feedback, practical help or simply an audience.
label.zh: 先问想要意见、实际帮忙，还是只想有人看看听听。

label.en: Talk about the expressive idea I can recognise in the piece.
label.zh: 聊聊自己在作品里看见的表达想法。

prompt.en: A hobby plan changes just as you are learning your part. What would you rather do?
prompt.zh: 刚熟悉自己的兴趣分工，计划就变了，你更愿意怎么应对？

label.en: Try a revised role while keeping the freedom to say what does not fit.
label.zh: 试试调整后的角色，也保留说不合适的自由。

label.en: Revisit the agreement so responsibilities remain clear and shared.
label.zh: 重看约定，让责任仍清楚且由大家分担。

label.en: Keep the central creative intention visible through the change.
label.zh: 让变化中仍看得见核心创作意图。

label.en: Maintain one small shared habit that makes the group feel connected.
label.zh: 留住一个让小组仍有联结感的小习惯。

prompt.en: Two people expect you to handle the same task in different ways. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 两个人希望你用不同方式处理同一件事，你更倾向什么？

label.en: Bring the expectations together and agree what I can actually take on.
label.zh: 把两边期待放一起，约好自己实际承担什么。

label.en: Explain which approach fits the idea I want the work to express.
label.zh: 说明哪种做法符合自己想表达的想法。

label.en: Start with a small shared exchange so the conversation feels less distant.
label.zh: 先有一点共同交流，让讨论不那么生分。

label.en: Work on one concrete detail that can clarify the difference.
label.zh: 先打磨一个能看清两种差别的具体细节。

prompt.en: Your small creative project could imitate a popular style or develop its own. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 一个小创作可以仿照流行风格，也可以发展自己的做法，你更愿意怎样选？

label.en: Keep the part of the idea that feels distinctly ours.
label.zh: 保留点子中最像自己的那一部分。

label.en: Choose the version that gives us an enjoyable shared memory.
label.zh: 选能给大家留下共同开心记忆的版本。

label.en: Explore the detail that I would enjoy refining over several attempts.
label.zh: 选一个自己愿意反复打磨的细节继续探索。

label.en: Match the version to what we can realistically finish together.
label.zh: 把版本和实际能共同完成的范围配好。

prompt.en: A friend is helping you settle into a new shared hobby space. What would you value most?
prompt.zh: 朋友帮你适应新的共用兴趣空间，你最珍惜哪种帮助？

label.en: A small ordinary gesture that makes being there feel less unfamiliar.
label.zh: 一点让待在那里不再陌生的日常心意。

label.en: Time to become familiar with the materials through patient practice.
label.zh: 有时间通过耐心练习熟悉材料。

label.en: A clear account of the resources and practical arrangements.
label.zh: 把资源和实际安排说明白。

label.en: An honest welcome that says what they enjoy about working together.
label.zh: 真诚欢迎，也说说喜欢怎样一起做事。

prompt.en: You have one free hour with a creative collaborator. Which use appeals most?
prompt.zh: 和创作伙伴有一个空闲小时，你更想怎么用？

label.en: Concentrate together on a detail we both want to refine.
label.zh: 一起专心打磨一处都想做好的细节。

label.en: Choose a limited goal and organise what we need to reach it.
label.zh: 选个有限目标，把所需条件安排好。

label.en: Speak openly about what each of us is excited to make.
label.zh: 坦率聊聊各自真正想做什么。

label.en: Swap roles briefly to see what a different approach feels like.
label.zh: 短暂换换角色，体验不同做法。

prompt.en: A casual showcase needs a simpler plan. What would you change first?
prompt.zh: 一次轻松的作品展示需要简化，你更想先改哪里？

label.en: Bring the aims, schedule and materials into a manageable match.
label.zh: 把目标、时间表和材料调整到能承担的范围。

label.en: Say plainly which part I would like to keep and why it matters.
label.zh: 直接说自己想保留哪部分、为什么在意。

label.en: Try a flexible format that gives unfamiliar contributions a chance.
label.zh: 试一个灵活形式，让陌生的贡献也有机会。

label.en: Agree on fair responsibilities and a clear way to revise the plan.
label.zh: 约好公平的责任和清楚的改计划方式。

prompt.en: You want to tell a group why you enjoy taking part. Which way feels closest?
prompt.zh: 想告诉小组自己为什么喜欢参加，你更接近哪种说法？

label.en: Name something specific I appreciate about creating with them.
label.zh: 具体说一件自己欣赏的共同创作体验。

label.en: Describe the room I have to try things and adjust my part.
label.zh: 说说自己有空间尝试，也能调整参与方式。

label.en: Mention the shared agreements that make joining sustainable for me.
label.zh: 提一提哪些共同约定让自己能持续参加。

label.en: Talk about the creative idea I can express without losing my own voice.
label.zh: 聊聊怎样表达创意而不丢掉自己的声音。

prompt.en: A project offers a role you have never tried. Which condition matters most to your choice?
prompt.zh: 项目给了你一个没试过的角色，决定时你最在意哪项条件？

label.en: Being able to explore it and revise my involvement as I learn.
label.zh: 可以探索，也可以随着了解调整参与。

label.en: Knowing what responsibilities are shared and what support is agreed.
label.zh: 知道哪些责任共同承担、哪些支持已经约好。

label.en: Having space to contribute an idea that still feels like my own.
label.zh: 有空间贡献仍然像自己的想法。

label.en: Feeling a small everyday connection with the people involved.
label.zh: 和参与的人有一点日常联结感。

prompt.en: After a shared creative session, what would you most like to review?
prompt.zh: 共同创作结束后，你最想回看什么？

label.en: Whether our agreements and responsibilities still fit everyone.
label.zh: 约定和责任是否仍适合每个人。

label.en: Whether the original expressive idea is still recognisable in what we made.
label.zh: 做出来的东西是否仍看得见最初表达。

label.en: The small moments that made the time feel shared.
label.zh: 哪些小瞬间让这段时间有共同感。

label.en: One detail I would enjoy returning to and refining.
label.zh: 哪处细节让自己还想回来继续打磨。
